articles.title: Weekend need-to-know: Polish and Ukranian festivals take over Toronto’s west end
articles.summary: Summer may be winding down but Toronto’s festivals are still going strong with several neighbourhoods celebrating their heritage and culture this weekend, including the Polish Festival in Roncesvalles and the Ukrainian Festival in Bloor West Village. Road closures will be in effect for the various fests and events as well as for the RBC Race […]

articles.summary: Toronto police were called to a high school in North York for the second day in a row after a possibly-armed person was seen in the area. articles.title: 15-year-old arrested after Riverdale schools placed in hold and secure Wednesday
articles.summary: Toronto police say a 15-year-old boy has been arrested in connection with an investigation in Riverdale that saw nine schools in the area placed under hold and secure or shelter in place orders on Wednesday. Police told CityNews that officers responded to a call at around 9:25 a.m. about a student that received a threat […]

articles.title: 'Don't close, don't sell': Union implores Stellantis to keep Brampton plant as automaker signals sale
articles.summary: The union representing Canadian workers at Stellantis is urging the automaker to keep its commitment to retooling its Brampton Ont., plant as the company looks poised to sell it instead.

articles.title: Strike action on the table if Stellantis sticks to plan to sell Brampton plant: union
articles.summary: TORONTO — The union representing more than 9,000 Stellantis workers in Canada says a strike is a "real possibility" after talks with the automaker broke down over its intent to sell an assembly plant in Brampton, Ont.

articles.title: York school board trustees vote on timeline to bring back police officers to schools
articles.summary: Trustees from the York Regional District School Board (YRDSB) passed a motion furthering a partnership between schools in the region and York police to keep schools safe.

articles.title: Teen arrested after young person stabbed in Etobicoke
articles.summary: Investigators with the Toronto Police Service (TPS) say they have arrested a 17-year-old boy after a young person was stabbed in Etobicoke on Thursday morning. articles.title: 16-year-old charged with 1st-degree murder after teen shot in North York
articles.summary: A teenager has been arrested three days after 17-year-old Cashie Auguste was fatally shot near Jane Street and Finch Avenue W., police say. The accused has been charged with first-degree murder and failure to comply with a probation order, investigators said in an update Thursday.

articles.title: King Street W. streetcar service changes are coming — again. Here's what you need to know
articles.summary: Major infrastructure work on a stretch of King Street W. will mean several changes to TTC streetcar service for 10 months starting this fall.

articles.title: Ford, Joly call on Stellantis to make new model at Brampton plant after automaker signals potential sale
articles.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford and federal Industry Minister Mélanie Joly are calling on Stellantis to produce a new model at its idled Brampton, Ont., assembly plant after the automaker signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel on its potential sale.

articles.title: Worker dead after being struck by commercial truck in Brampton: police
articles.summary: A man has died in an industrial accident after being struck by a truck during road work, according to Peel Regional Police.

articles.title: Crown drops charge against Toronto man accused in Pearson airport gold heist
articles.summary: Prosecutors have withdrawn a charge against a Toronto man accused of taking part in the multimillion-dollar gold heist at Pearson airport in 2023.

articles.title: Ford supports Carney's plan for private investors Toronto's Pearson airport
articles.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford is fully on board with the prime minister's plan to see private investors take over operations at Canada's four largest airports, including Toronto Pearson, he said Wednesday.

articles.title: Mississauga city council votes to block data centre projects for 1 year
articles.summary: Mississauga city council has voted unanimously on a moratorium on new data centres for one year, the latest municipality to hit the brakes on the artificial intelligence-fuelled build out.

articles.title: Sanofi launching $925M vaccine manufacturing facility in North York
articles.summary: French pharmaceutical company Sanofi officially launched its new $925 million vaccine manufacturing facility in North York on Wednesday — a site that will be used to create high-dose flu vaccines for seniors in Canada.
